scope: LaDe Hangzhou V2 conditional economic analysis; not empirical profitability validation
workflow: ARS scoped source verification, continuous execution; no new field observations
price_basis: Nominal CNY from explicitly dated sources. No inflation adjustment, tax-credit normalization or common-year deflator. This is not a constant-2026-price forecast.

S1.title: 顺丰：包装服务—常规包装收费标准
S1.limits: Retail packaging-service tariff, not bulk procurement invoice. 24/36 L external geometries bracket the model's assumed 30 L; neither proves an identical SKU. Local availability/prices may vary.

S2.title: 可循环快递包装“最后一公里”如何打通？
S2.locator: 中通快递山西管理中心负责人对循环箱的价格和次数举例
S2.limits: Historical company interview; exact 30 L/2 kg SKU unconfirmed. Fifty uses is an illustrative/design reference, not observed average survival. Purchase allocation excludes cleaning, reverse transport and handling.

S3.title: 杭州市2023年企业薪酬调查信息
S3.publisher: 杭州市人力资源和社会保障部门，浙江政务云公开附件
S3.locator: PDF p.10 中级道路货运汽车驾驶员；p.4 邮政和快递服务人员；p.18-19 工资统计口径
S3.limits: Occupational wage statistics, not this operator's payroll. Includes bonuses/allowances/overtime. The conversion to productive minutes and employer-cost multiplier below are assumptions, not prescribed rates.

S4.title: 中国商用车电动化发展研究报告
S4.limits: Class-average research input, not matched-fleet fuel logs. 2019 is the report's historical baseline; do not relabel it as Hangzhou telemetry. 2025 entries are forecasts. Both layers use a light-diesel proxy pending actual vehicle identification; E2 might instead be electric.

S5.title: 浙江省丽水市2026年5月份成品油市场运行情况
S5.publisher: 丽水市商务局／商务部浙江商务预报
S5.limits: Dated Zhejiang-city retail reference, not current Hangzhou transaction price or annual average. Chosen because the primary source explicitly provides CNY/L.

S6.title: 2026年9月24日国家继续实施调控，成品油价格适当调整
S6.publisher: 国家发展和改革委员会
S6.locator: 附件，浙江省，柴油（标准品），单位元/吨
S6.limits: Newest verified official mass price in this search. Not inserted into the CNY/L field; no undocumented tonne-to-liter conversion. Base S5 is deliberately dated, not presented as the latest price.

S7.title: 可循环快递包装规模化应用研究
S7.publisher: 摆脱塑缚、广东省循环经济和资源综合利用协会
S7.limits: Original draft-standard trial files were not obtained. Secondary evidence only, outside the current AOI/day closed-loop scenario. Nonreturn at a reporting cutoff is not established permanent loss. The report itself cautions that 1–3 CNY is likely box purchase allocation, not cleaning or total circulation cost. Excluded from executable baseline.

distance_scale_to_km.note: LaDe V2 provenance distance_unit=km; does not apply to Zhou coordinates.

e1_distance_cost_per_km.note: Fuel and maintenance only. No wage, depreciation, insurance, toll or rent here.

e2_distance_cost_per_km.note: Same class-average fuel proxy as E1; not evidence of identical measured consumption.

e1_vehicle_cost_per_cycle.note: Illustrative non-labor fixed vehicle allocation; includes assumed depreciation/insurance, excludes fuel/maintenance. Not a rental quote.

e2_vehicle_cost_per_cycle.note: Same boundary as E1; amount is uncalibrated.

single_use_package_price.note: F4 reference, not a matched-volume procurement price; 1-3 CNY stress cases have no verified matching procurement source.

cleaning_cost_per_return.note: Retained scenario allowance for warehouse sorting/cleaning, with warehouse labor included. Do not add warehouse wages again.

tracking_cost_per_use.note: Assumed non-labor IT/label allocation only; driver scan labor must not be counted twice with trip work time.

single_use_disposal_cost_per_package.note: No extra operator payment or resale credit claimed without an invoice. Zero is not a claim of zero social/environmental disposal cost.

pool_lifetime_cycles.note: Whole-pool replacement every 50 repeated B1 cycles. Equivalent to 50 issues per box only when N=Q. Never copy to M5 as a 50-day physical lifetime.

container_lifetime_uses.note: M5 wear allocation = issued * price / uses; no random losses, aging or replacement cash scheduling.

evaluation_cycles.note: Repeated-demand scenario; not 300 observed days and not the annual wage conversion denominator.

sensitivity.interpretation: Scenario grids, not confidence intervals or empirical distributions. Only B1 packaging-price and lifetime grids are automatically swept by run_single_batch_comparison.py. Other grids require regenerated profiles and explicit runs.

excluded_external_calibration.exclusion_reason: Cross-day consumer-return trial summary, not the modeled same-day transport-box service. Original trial documentation and observation horizon unverified. Requires a different inventory/late-return/loss model; do not insert 0.051 as permanent per-use loss.
excluded_external_calibration.legacy_loss_rate_0_03: Unverified assumption; not a live field of the current full-return model.

unresolved_measurements: Matched-SKU container and carton procurement invoice; container tare/usable volume and parcel packing ratio
Actual E1/E2 vehicle model, fuel/energy logs, lease/depreciation/insurance, and route tolls
Employer payroll burden, paid shift time and inter-trip idle-time attribution
Warehouse cleaning throughput, delay, utilities, labor and equipment cost
Per-container use history, late-return distribution, permanent loss and retirement causes
Verified depot/satellite locations and original LaDe raw-file availability
